sources.notes: 50 pages. The testable section is Parts 1 to 4 and the glossary (pages 8 to 44 of the PDF). The licence does not cover the Commonwealth Coat of Arms; the acknowledgments page lists images supplied by others. The cover gives no publication date, and the copyright line says 2020 although the text has been revised since, so no date is recorded.

sources.title: Australian citizenship practice test
sources.notes: An interactive test of 20 questions; only its opening page is saved. The page carries no copyright or licence notice and no link to one, and it sits on its own address, outside the website the Department's Creative Commons statement speaks of. Its questions are not imported. It says: "This is a sample test only. The questions will be different on the day of the test."

not_found.searched: The Department publishes no list of test questions. The "Prepare for the citizenship test" page says only that all questions are based on the booklet, and offers a practice test whose questions "will be different on the day of the test".

The "Learn about the citizenship interview and test" page describes the interview held for people who do not sit the test, but gives no list of questions asked at it. Nothing of the kind is linked from the test pages.
